items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 37:1
items.html: All of ZON is the discernment of the body. And the five discernments KHB ZON are called in it HGT NHY, because the first three, KHB, descended in it to the discernment of three Hassadim alone, and therefore they were changed to the name HGT, as is known. Therefore the Tifferet is the Bina of the body, and it includes within itself ten Sefirot: the GAR of Bina are the upper third of Tifferet up to the Chazeh [chest], and the seven lower Sefirot of Bina are the two lower thirds of Tifferet. (Part 1, Page 888, Sub Header, "and he raised").
